acceptance_criteria_before_future_traini.description: A tracked receipt must enumerate train/validation/test signer ids, signer counts, per-label signer support, and train-to-held-out overlap for the high-signal region-grid manifests.
The contract must state whether the next evaluation target is signer-disjoint generalization, signer-overlap diagnostic learning, or product fallback, and why that target is acceptable.

The contract must carry per-label decisions for held-out zero-recall and never-predicted labels, including whether each label is retained, held out, dropped from the next diagnostic, or routed to crop QA.
The contract must include a deterministic per-region quality summary or explicitly defer crop work with a reason. A future training prompt cannot rely only on tiny memorization.
If satisfying the contract requires new source approval, manual labels, data collection, paid compute, or Brev auth, the loop must stop for human scope approval instead of training.

blocked_actions_requiring_human_approval: Brev login, worker inspection, worker lifecycle changes, or paid compute
any training run, model fitting, optimizer/backward pass, checkpoint creation, or sweep
source import, source approval expansion, generated pseudo-labels, or manual annotation/data collection
ONNX export, model-card promotion, browser trained activation, final-readiness claim, or final-gate changes

guardrails.non_promotion: This design is not training, calibration, export, browser activation, final readiness, or evidence that the M3AW recognizer generalizes.

method.description: Loaded existing JSON/Markdown artifacts, extracted deterministic M3AY/M3AW/M3AX facts, ranked remediation lanes, and selected one no-training contract scaffold.

ranked_remediation_hypotheses.design_implication: Before any future training, add a split/signer contract that makes the intended generalization target explicit and gates any training prompt on per-label signer/split support and held-out coverage evidence.
evidence: held-out prediction label coverage is 3 validation labels and 3 test labels
same-label descriptive crop-stat drift loses to another train label in 10 split-label rows

ranked_remediation_hypotheses.design_implication: A crop-region contract should follow the split/signer contract or be folded into it, requiring explicit per-region quality thresholds and label-level drift checks before training.
evidence: M3AX memorization succeeded with the same region-grid path, so crop-region statistics are a likely generalization surface rather than a total input-path break

ranked_remediation_hypotheses.design_implication: The next contract should preserve these labels as hold/drop/split candidates, but choosing a narrower vocabulary without first documenting signer/split support would hide the main generalization weakness.
evidence: labels never predicted on both held-out splits: ['please', 'sad', 'table', 'white']

ranked_remediation_hypotheses.design_implication: Data-quality checks are useful acceptance criteria, but this prompt should not import sources, collect data, or manually relabel clips.
evidence: M3AY low-signal and crop-stat tables identify candidate outlier clips
Current manifests and tensors are usable for diagnostics but not enough to explain generalization by accuracy alone

ranked_remediation_hypotheses.design_implication: Product fallback remains the honest runtime state, but the evidence still supports one bounded no-training contract scaffold before stopping recognizer remediation entirely.
evidence: M3AW held-out smoke is not promotable
M3AX tiny memorization is diagnostic only

selected_remediation_lane.why_not_training_now: M3AW failed held-out metrics and M3AY shows unresolved split/crop/vocabulary drift. Training, Brev, export, or browser activation would be ungrounded until a contract defines what evidence must change.
selected_remediation_lane.why_selected: Empty train-to-held-out signer overlap plus prediction collapse means the next useful no-training artifact is a split/signer contract. Crop and vocabulary decisions should be recorded inside that contract rather than launching another training attempt.
